annotation_description: GPT54 Villain declined to cast Elemental Uprising during combat when the opponent had no creatures on the battlefield. This would have dealt 4 damage for free — animating the sick Forest (which gains haste from Uprising) into a 4/4 attacker, using Thriving Grove + Forest to pay the {1}{G} cost. They can still play a land postcombat and Cultivate next turn on 3 mana. At 20 life, 4 damage isn't game-changing, but it's essentially free value.
human_notes: the forest would be tapped by casting the spell.

annotation_description: Playing Thriving Heath (enters tapped) instead of Mountain means GPT5 Valley can't cast anything this turn. Playing Mountain would give Plains + Mountain = 2 untapped mana, allowing Daybreak Charger (1W) to be cast immediately as a 3/1 body. The ETB +2/+0 has no great target, but deploying a creature is much better than doing nothing.
human_notes: different land would allow playing a two drop
